title: Dragon Fruit Peel-Derived Heterogeneous Catalyst for Michael Addition Reactions and Methanolysis of PET Waste: A Green and Dual-Functional Approach

In this study, we investigate the innovative use of low-cost Dragon fruit peel-derived heterogeneous catalyst for two environmentally significant reactions: the Michael addition reactions and the methanolysis of PET waste....
